title: Aurum Alpha evaluated flag set
description: standards/038-feature-flags.md FF7: the document a browser receives instead of evaluating flags itself — the flags member of the application configuration fetched at load (090 WC2, GET /api/config). The server evaluated these with the session's subject as context; the client renders from them and the server still evaluates the same flags and runs the permission check on every request (FF5). Carries only flags declared served_to_client. Object-typed flags are not served to the client. schemaVersion 1 — evolves additively per PC6.

schema_version.description: PC6: the version of this shape.

evaluated_at.description: FF7: when the server evaluated the set, so a client can decide whether its documented refresh is due. Canonical instant per 020 IP4.

flags.description: FF7: flag name to evaluated value. Names follow FF2's grammar; values are the scalar the flag's type admits.
